data: Which language has the highest overall tagging accuracy for the MELT+lexicon model?

The figure shows a line graph with different symbols representing the four types of enriched models. The MELT+lexicon model is represented by black circles. By examining the graph, we can see that the highest point on the graph corresponds to the black circle, indicating the language with the highest overall tagging accuracy for the MELT+lexicon model.
